doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks and close
summary: Kimery thanks her on behalf of the Smithsonian and NEA; she thanks him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: [Laughs] And with that Carla I really thank you. It’s been a pleasure, joy and an honor for me to be able to sit with you for this past couple of hours. We just scratched the surface of your voluminous career. It’s been such a treat and heartfelt thanks and gratitude for you spending time with me.
And on behalf of the Smithsonian, and the National Endowment for the Arts, I want to thank you again.
